statements.statement: The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has recurrent episodes of supraventricular tachycardia
The patient experiences palpitations and lightheadedness
CPT code 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
Diagnosis codes G45.9 and I47.1 were submitted
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to assess the efficacy of current rate-control therapy
